Register the independent RGB image with ExitStack before closing oriented/decoded inputs; release source cores before thumbnail/rebuild
Attempt other registered cleanup even when one close raises, retaining prior error context
Preserve image conversion algorithms, formats, dimensions, admission limits, async shielding and actual thread draining
